topic: How does the LPF's 25 GHz stopband impact interference mitigation in multi-beam satellite downlink frequency planning?
consensus_response: The LPF's 25 GHz stopband reduces inter-beam interference by creating a physical guard band, but at the cost of spectral efficiency. Steeper roll-off characteristics enhance interference suppression, while advanced beamforming and precoding techniques can further mitigate interference, optimizing system performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems use analog beamforming for interference mitigation in 17.3-30 GHz bands, with phased array architectures and single RF chains.
